sources.snippet: 1. Purpose slopify turns a plain description into the most over-the-top, obvious "AI slop" clickbait social-media post possible. It does this not in one shot but through a fixed number of iterative amplification passes, where each pass takes the previous pass's output as its input and escalates it further. Only the final pass is delivered to the user.

sources.title: GitHub - hobsojam/slopify: Make human-written text look like AI slop ...
sources.snippet: Transform log. Every run records before/after snapshots per transform step (TransformLog). deslopify replays that log backwards to exactly undo a slopify run. It is not a general "clean up any AI text" tool -- that needs a log to replay against, or a real rewrite model for arbitrary input. triplets is a stub.

sources.snippet: Slopify pick-ticket "knows" the basics of the source code, but it does not know much about the product and language only applicable to a higher level product view. Ideally the subtickets are one sentence (Just the title), for example "Expose model X to the API", "Make the field X on model Y filterable in the admin" and similiar
